question: The effective resistance of a parallel connection that consists of four wires of equal length, equal area of cross-section and same material is $0.25\ \Omega$. What will be the effective resistance if they are connected in series ?
solution:
Parallel: $\dfrac{R}{4} = 0.25$, so each wire has $R = 1\ \Omega$.

Series: $4R = 4\ \Omega$.
